environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed as part of a Step Functions state machine for user account lifecycle management. The Lambda execution role has full network access to the RDS PostgreSQL instance. The DB_USER environment variable is set to 'app_admin' which has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables. The Step Functions workflow accepts input from an API Gateway endpoint with no request validation template. The RDS instance is in the same VPC with security group allowing inbound 5432 from the Lambda security group.

config.db_privileges: ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public
config.network: Lambda and RDS in same VPC, SG allows 5432
